The PSVDAG–SVDAG Conversion Algorithm was proposed to bridge the gap between the space-efficient but hard-to-access PSVDAG structure and the rendering-friendly SVDAG structure.
The algorithm allows the use of PSVDAG for storage and SVDAG for rendering, converting on the fly or as a preprocessing step.
